title: Protect access and store data
description: Use these guides only for a missing workstation or damaged local storage. They lead to the existing controlled recovery tools; opening a guide does not resolve the incident by itself.

lostDevice.title: A device is lost or stolen
lostDevice.description: Identify its role before blocking access or pairing a replacement.
lostDevice.safety: Keep selling only from a verified device. Revocation does not remotely erase a missing workstation.

steps.1: Find the terminal by name, site, last activity, and device role.
steps.2: If it is a hub client, revoke it and confirm the audited result.
steps.3: If it is the authority or local store device, preserve it and contact support to rotate access.

damagedStorage.title: This workstation cannot open its data
damagedStorage.description: Preserve the latest good encrypted backup before reinstalling or restoring.
damagedStorage.safety: Do not delete app data, replace files, or reinstall before checking the backup.

steps.1: Stop using the affected workstation and keep its files unchanged.
steps.2: On desktop, verify the latest encrypted snapshot with the restore drill.
steps.3: Restore only after integrity passes; otherwise export diagnostics and contact support.
